feeding_claim.verbatim: They eat a rich diversified diet of native prairie grasses, legumes and forbs.

notes: Gary and Shirley Foltz, Angus and Hereford cow-calf herd on native pasture in the Southern Flint Hills, south of Dexter off US 166. Read homepage, about us, FAQ, products, by-the-cut, quarter and news pages, plus the Square online store story page (store page returned only metadata). WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote. FAQ heads 'What is 100% grass-fed?' and says 'Our 100% grass-fed cattle are free of synthetic hormones...', but also says cattle get 'a low starch protein supplement' and mentions a 'finishing program' without describing it, so category kept at the cautious grass-fed. About page says they sell 'at home, at farmers markets by the cut' and in bulk, and 'recently began placing our meat products in stores'; no market names given on the site (an earlier lead from From the Land of Kansas mentions Winfield and Derby markets, unconfirmed). By-the-cut page: 'We maintain a supply of USDA cut meats for resale at the farm'; homepage says online store orders are 'delivered directly to your door' but names no area, and 'Additional delivery costs may apply', so no local-delivery channel or area set. Quarter, half and whole priced per lb hanging weight (2025 prices), customer pays processing at the locker. 'Why Grass Fed?' page is blank. Content partly dated (one price list says May 2022).
